    rem = 1 << 32
    res_a = 1 << 32
    res_b = 1 << 32

    for b in range(1, n + 1):
        a = max(x * b // y - 10, 0)
        for j in range(20):

                    rem = diff
                    res_a = candidate
                    res_b = b
    print(f"{res_a}/{res_b}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
